---
title: "Host composition in treecluster genotypes"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-30"
---

## Objectives
* For each treecluster genotype (tc_geno), count the number of unique hosts (taxa2 and order) and total sequences
* Restrict to genotypes with >= min_n sequences AND >= min_taxa2 unique taxa2 hosts
* Plot genotypes on x-axis (ranked by number of unique hosts descending), n sequences on y-axis, filled by host composition
* Annotate bars with N unique hosts; add a separate plot of unique host counts per genotype

# Setup
## Parameters
```{r}
min_n     <- 50    # minimum sequences per genotype
min_taxa2 <- 3     # minimum unique taxa2 per genotype 
```

## Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(gtools)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Plotting
```{r}
plot.theme <- theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.background = element_rect("grey95"),
                    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                    text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
                    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6),
                    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 70, unit = "mm"))
```

## Inputs and outputs
```{r}
meta.in    <- "../../../../data/08_clean-share/meta/metadata.csv"
palette.in <- "../../../../data/06_host/multi-taxa/taxa_palette/taxa_colors_refined_contrast.csv"

date.out <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
f.out    <- paste0(date.out, "_out/")
dir.create(f.out, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Data
## Load metadata
```{r}
meta <- read_csv(meta.in, show_col_types = FALSE)

# tc_geno -> shorter genotype alias, used for x-axis labels across all plots
alias.lookup <- meta %>%
  distinct(tc_geno, treecluster_genotype_alias) %>%
  deframe()
```

## Load taxa2 colour palette and define group-ordered factor levels
```{r}
pal.df <- read_csv(palette.in, show_col_types = FALSE)
taxa2.pal <- setNames(pal.df$color_hex, pal.df$taxa2)
```

## Filter to genotypes meeting thresholds
```{r}
geno.summary <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(tc_geno)) %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(
    n_seq   = n(),
    n_taxa2 = n_distinct(taxa2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_order = n_distinct(order, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

geno.keep <- geno.summary %>%
  filter(n_seq >= min_n, n_taxa2 >= min_taxa2)

cat("Genotypes passing filters (n_seq >=", min_n, "& n_taxa2 >=", min_taxa2, "):", nrow(geno.keep), "\n")
cat("Genotypes excluded:", nrow(geno.summary) - nrow(geno.keep), "\n")
```

## Subset metadata to kept genotypes
```{r}
meta.filt <- meta %>%
  filter(tc_geno %in% geno.keep$tc_geno, !is.na(tc_geno))

# genotypes with at least one mammal sample (host_group == "Mammals" in palette)
mammal.taxa2 <- pal.df %>% filter(host_group == "Mammals") %>% pull(taxa2)
mammal.genos <- meta.filt %>%
  filter(taxa2 %in% mammal.taxa2) %>%
  pull(tc_geno) %>%
  unique()
```

# Plots
## taxa2 composition
```{r}
# rank genotypes by n_taxa2 descending, then n_seq for ties
geno.order.taxa2 <- geno.keep %>%
  arrange(desc(n_taxa2), desc(n_seq)) %>%
  pull(tc_geno)

# stacked counts: one row per genotype x taxa2
taxa2.counts <- meta.filt %>%
  count(tc_geno, taxa2) %>%
  mutate(tc_geno = factor(tc_geno, levels = geno.order.taxa2))

# order taxa2 levels by overall frequency (most to least) for legend and fill
taxa2.ordered <- taxa2.counts %>%
  group_by(taxa2) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(taxa2) %>%
  as.character()

taxa2.counts <- taxa2.counts %>%
  mutate(taxa2 = factor(taxa2, levels = c(taxa2.ordered,
                                          setdiff(unique(as.character(taxa2)), taxa2.ordered))))

# any taxa2 not in palette get a fallback grey
missing.taxa2 <- setdiff(levels(taxa2.counts$taxa2), names(taxa2.pal))
if (length(missing.taxa2) > 0) {
  taxa2.pal <- c(taxa2.pal, setNames(rep("#AAAAAA", length(missing.taxa2)), missing.taxa2))
}

# annotation: total n_seq, n_taxa2, and mammal flag per genotype
annot.taxa2 <- taxa2.counts %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n), n_unique = n_distinct(taxa2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n_unique))

gap <- max(annot.taxa2$total_n) * 0.01   # small gap between bar top and label

p.taxa2 <- ggplot(taxa2.counts, aes(x = tc_geno, y = n, fill = taxa2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(data = annot.taxa2,
            aes(x = tc_geno, y = total_n + gap, label = label),
            angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5,
            fontface = "plain", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = taxa2.pal, name = "Host taxa") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = alias.lookup) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "TreeCluster genotype alias", y = "Number of sequences") +
  plot.theme

ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_host_taxa2_composition.pdf"),
       p.taxa2, width = 14, height = 8)
ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_host_taxa2_composition.png"),
       p.taxa2, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

p.taxa2
```

## order composition
```{r}
# rank genotypes by n_order descending, then n_seq for ties (restrict to n_order > 1)
geno.order.order <- geno.keep %>%
  filter(n_order > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_order), desc(n_seq)) %>%
  pull(tc_geno)

order.counts <- meta.filt %>%
  filter(tc_geno %in% geno.order.order) %>%
  count(tc_geno, order) %>%
  mutate(tc_geno = factor(tc_geno, levels = geno.order.order))

# order the order levels by overall frequency (most to least); the same level
# order drives the fill factor, the stacked bar, and the legend
order.freq <- order.counts %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total))
order.levels <- order.freq$order
order.counts <- order.counts %>%
  mutate(order = factor(order, levels = order.levels))

# classify each order as mammal vs avian via taxa2 -> host_group
order.group <- meta.filt %>%
  filter(tc_geno %in% geno.order.order) %>%
  left_join(pal.df %>% select(taxa2, host_group), by = "taxa2") %>%
  count(order, host_group) %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

mammal.orders <- order.levels[order.levels %in%
  (order.group %>% filter(host_group == "Mammals") %>% pull(order))]
avian.orders  <- setdiff(order.levels, mammal.orders)

# distinct divergent/qualitative palette per group; shuffle the colour->order
# mapping so frequency-adjacent orders do not receive similar colours
set.seed(42)
avian.pal  <- sample(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(length(avian.orders)))
# drop Dark2's trailing grey (#666666) so mammal orders never read as NA grey
mammal.pal <- sample(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[1:7])(length(mammal.orders)))
order.pal <- c(setNames(avian.pal, avian.orders),
               setNames(mammal.pal, mammal.orders))

annot.order <- order.counts %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n), n_unique = n_distinct(order), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n_unique))

gap <- max(annot.order$total_n) * 0.01   # small gap between bar top and label

p.order <- ggplot(order.counts, aes(x = tc_geno, y = n, fill = order)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(data = annot.order,
            aes(x = tc_geno, y = total_n + gap, label = label),
            angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5,
            fontface = "plain", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = order.pal, name = "Order", na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = alias.lookup) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "TreeCluster genotype alias", y = "Number of sequences") +
  plot.theme

ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_host_order_composition.pdf"),
       p.order, width = 14, height = 8)
ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_host_order_composition.png"),
       p.order, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

p.order
```

## Unique host counts per genotype
```{r}
# unique common hosts per genotype (exclude non-host labels)
non.host <- c("Environment", "Unknown", "Unknown bird")
common.per.geno <- meta %>%
  filter(tc_geno %in% geno.order.taxa2, !is.na(common_host), !common_host %in% non.host) %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(n_common = n_distinct(common_host), .groups = "drop")

# Long format: n_order and n_common (common host) per genotype
unique.long <- geno.keep %>%
  filter(tc_geno %in% geno.order.taxa2) %>%
  left_join(common.per.geno, by = "tc_geno") %>%
  mutate(tc_geno = factor(tc_geno, levels = geno.order.taxa2)) %>%
  select(tc_geno, n_order, n_common) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(n_order, n_common),
               names_to  = "host_level",
               values_to = "n_unique") %>%
  mutate(host_level = recode(host_level,
                             "n_order"  = "Order",
                             "n_common" = "common host"))

p.unique <- ggplot(unique.long, aes(x = tc_geno, y = n_unique, fill = host_level)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("common host" = "#4E6C88", "Order" = "#C65A3A"),
                    name = "host level") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = alias.lookup) +
  labs(x = "TreeCluster genotype alias", y = "Number of unique hosts") +
  plot.theme

ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_unique_host_counts.pdf"),
       p.unique, width = 14, height = 6)
ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_unique_host_counts.png"),
       p.unique, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p.unique
```

## common host composition (genotypes with > 25 common hosts)
```{r}
min_common <- 25   # minimum unique common hosts for a genotype to be shown
min_host_n <- 10   # hosts with fewer total samples (in this subset) -> "Other"

# common_host is a common-name column in the metadata; drop non-host labels
non.host <- c("Environment", "Unknown", "Unknown bird")

# genotypes with > min_common unique common hosts, ranked descending
common.keep <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(tc_geno), !is.na(common_host), !common_host %in% non.host) %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(n_common = n_distinct(common_host), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_common > min_common) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_common))

cat("Genotypes with >", min_common, "unique common hosts:", nrow(common.keep), "\n")

# raw sequence counts per genotype x common_host within these genotypes
common.raw <- meta %>%
  filter(tc_geno %in% common.keep$tc_geno, !common_host %in% non.host, !is.na(common_host)) %>%
  count(tc_geno, common_host)

# hosts with >= min_host_n total samples (across this subset) are coloured
# individually; rarer ones are lumped into "Other" to keep the legend manageable
named.hosts <- common.raw %>%
  group_by(common_host) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(total >= min_host_n) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(common_host)

cat("Common hosts kept (>=", min_host_n, "samples):", length(named.hosts),
    "+ Other =", length(named.hosts) + 1, "legend entries\n")

# label for the lumped bucket carries the sample threshold
other.lab <- paste0("Other (N<", min_host_n, ")")

common.counts <- common.raw %>%
  mutate(common_host = ifelse(common_host %in% named.hosts, common_host, other.lab)) %>%
  count(tc_geno, common_host, wt = n, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(tc_geno = factor(tc_geno, levels = common.keep$tc_geno),
         common_host = factor(common_host, levels = c(named.hosts, other.lab)))

# divergent ramp across named hosts, shuffled so neighbours differ; Other = grey
set.seed(42)
common.pal <- c(
  setNames(sample(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(length(named.hosts))),
           named.hosts),
  setNames("grey80", other.lab)
)

# annotate each bar with the true number of unique common hosts
annot.common <- common.counts %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(common.keep, by = "tc_geno") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n_common))

gap <- max(annot.common$total_n) * 0.01   # small gap between bar top and label

p.common <- ggplot(common.counts, aes(x = tc_geno, y = n, fill = common_host)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(data = annot.common,
            aes(x = tc_geno, y = total_n + gap, label = label),
            angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5,
            fontface = "plain", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = common.pal, name = "Common host") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = alias.lookup) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, keyheight = unit(3, "mm"))) +
  labs(x = paste0("TreeCluster genotype alias (N>", min_common, ")"),
       y = "Number of sequences (n = number of common hosts)") +
  plot.theme +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "plain"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.justification = "bottom",
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_common_host_composition.pdf"),
       p.common, width = 14, height = 9)
ggsave(paste0(f.out, date.out, "_tc_geno_common_host_composition.png"),
       p.common, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)

p.common
```
